hook.name: PeepsV4TaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for meme token launches that skims configurable buy/sell taxes via BeforeSwapDelta, overrides LP fee to 1%, and distributes collected taxes to funds, burn, dividend, and liquidity sinks. Enforces exact-input-only swaps, blocks swaps during a clearing window, and restricts third-party liquidity additions via a time-based anti-farmer lock.
